CustomField.description: Automatically calculated status showing where the student is in the assessment process.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( CONTAINS(TEXT( Grade_Applied__c ) ,"K"), CONTAINS(TEXT(Grade_Applied__c ),"1"), NOT(CONTAINS(TEXT(EnrollmentStatus),"Phase")), CONTAINS(TEXT( LearnerAccount.Student_Type__c ),"Returning") ), "N/A", IF( ISBLANK(Scheduled_Assessment_Date__c), "Need to schedule", IF( OR( CONTAINS(TEXT(Family_Decision__c),"Accept"), CONTAINS(TEXT(Family_Decision__c),"Decline") ), "Complete", IF( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Zeta_Decision__c))), "Approved, but needs call", IF( OR( CONTAINS(TEXT(Student_able_to_complete_Assessment__c),"unable"), AND( OR( CONTAINS(TEXT(Student_able_to_complete_Assessment__c),"Yes, but"), CONTAINS(TEXT(Student_able_to_complete_Assessment__c),"Yes, completed") ), OR( AND( OR(CQ1_Score__c=1,CQ1_Score__c=0), OR(CQ2_Score__c=1,CQ2_Score__c=0), OR(CQ3_Score__c=1,CQ3_Score__c=0), OR(CQ4_Score__c=1,CQ4_Score__c=0), Number_of_Errors__c<>NULL, Completed_Assessment_Date__c<>NULL ), AND( OR(ELA_Q1_Score__c=1,ELA_Q1_Score__c=0), OR(ELA_Q2_Score__c=1,ELA_Q2_Score__c=0), OR(ELA_Q3_Score__c=1,ELA_Q3_Score__c=0), OR(ELA_Q4_Score__c=1,ELA_Q4_Score__c=0), OR(Math_Q1_Score__c=1,Math_Q1_Score__c=0), OR(Math_Q2_Score__c=1,Math_Q2_Score__c=0), OR(Math_Q3_Score__c=1,Math_Q3_Score__c=0) ) ) ) ), "Administered, but not approved", IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Scheduled_Assessment_Date__c)), ISBLANK(Completed_Assessment_Date__c) ), "Scheduled but not administered", IF( AND( Scheduled_Assessment_Date__c <= NOW(), ISBLANK(Completed_Assessment_Date__c), CONTAINS(TEXT(Student_able_to_complete_Assessment__c),"did not") ), "Scheduled, but not administered", IF( OR( CONTAINS(TEXT(Student_able_to_complete_Assessment__c),"Yes, but"), CONTAINS(TEXT(Student_able_to_complete_Assessment__c),"Yes, completed"), OR(CQ1_Score__c=1,CQ1_Score__c=0), OR(CQ2_Score__c=1,CQ2_Score__c=0), OR(CQ3_Score__c=1,CQ3_Score__c=0), OR(CQ4_Score__c=1,CQ4_Score__c=0), Number_of_Errors__c<>NULL, Completed_Assessment_Date__c<>NULL, OR(ELA_Q1_Score__c=1,ELA_Q1_Score__c=0), OR(ELA_Q2_Score__c=1,ELA_Q2_Score__c=0), OR(ELA_Q3_Score__c=1,ELA_Q3_Score__c=0), OR(ELA_Q4_Score__c=1,ELA_Q4_Score__c=0), OR(Math_Q1_Score__c=1,Math_Q1_Score__c=0), OR(Math_Q2_Score__c=1,Math_Q2_Score__c=0), OR(Math_Q3_Score__c=1,Math_Q3_Score__c=0), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ELA_Q1__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ELA_Q2__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ELA_Q3__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ELA_Q4__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Math_Q1__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Math_Q2__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Math_Q3__c))) ), "Being Administered", "Need to schedule" ) ) ) ) ) ) ) )
